name: train4 single-pass distill of train3 guarded outputs

early_stop: window-mean CE < 0.05, or jump >1.0 after mean < 0.2; roll back to last checkpoint
input: character card + chapter-locked bge RAG + question (same as merged eval)

generate.repetition_penalty: 1.15 on the teacher pass only. Off for the shipped merge and the headline eval.

generate.note: Smoke on the trained adapter: 0/20 loops with the penalty and 0/20 without. The penalty produced near-names (Agrappa, Morritz, Cliversal, Thoneon, Waldmann). The no-penalty pass had 0 near-names. Headline eval and merged generation_config therefore omit the penalty. It is a safety net that this checkpoint does not need. Official rag_base remains the train1 run.
